title: Resident Trust Fund Accounts: Closing and Conveyance Terms
content:
When a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account ends, the remaining money and a final accounting go to the person the event designates. The terms are the same in all six tiers (Medicaid and Non-Medicaid; Self-Directed, Representative Payee and Guardianship).

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Conveyance of funds and final accounting | within 30 calendar days after discharge or death |
| Payee on discharge | the resident or the resident's legal representative |
| Payee after death | the estate, through the personal representative holding letters from the Register of Wills |
| How funds are conveyed | by check |
| A resident who stays may withdraw everything and close the account | Yes |

## Counting the 30 days (hypothetical dates)

The count runs in calendar days from the date of discharge or the date of death. For a discharge on 9 March, the 30th calendar day is 8 April; a conveyance check dated 8 April is within the period, one dated 9 April is not.
